newsitem.title: UK: US stocks mixed in London, auto shares firm.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mixed in London, auto shares firm.

text.p: U.S. shares were narrowly mixed in quiet trading in London on Thursday.
In an otherwise trendless market, light bargain-hunting lifted the automobile sector, dealers said.
Shares in Ford Motor Co, which the Wall Street Journal said was considering a dividend hike, were up $1/4 to $33-1/8.
Shares in General Motors Corp and Chrysler Corp each added $1/8 to $54-5/8 and $30-1/8, respectively.
News that Woolworth Corp's chief financial officer Andrew Hines resigned dragged the retailer's shares down $1/4 in London to $22-1/8, dealers said.
Among technology stocks, shares in International Business Machines Corp, which fell $3-1/2 in New York on Wednesday, slipped $1/4 in London to $132-7/8. Shares in Intel Corp also lost $1/4 to $142.
Dealers said many European investors were holding back ahead of the release of important U.S. inflation data, due for release on Friday.
"I think we'll see a broadly flat to mixed market at the open," said one.
At 1025 GMT, June S&P 500 index futures were down 0.05 point to 765.55. June long bond futures were unchanged at 107-11/32.
